narrative.details: Examine the vessel of his rebirth, mortal. It is from this that the Windseeker shall be reborn!
narrative.objectives: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.
narrative.offerRewardText: May you be protected in your crusade. May the Master bless your efforts.
narrative.requestItemsText: Will you release him from his eternal prison?
